remainingAcceptance.title: Behavioral review of every script
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Per-script input/output/side-effect, failure, timing and research-boundary review with linked evidence; targeted regressions for defects. Inventory/syntax alone cannot close this.

remainingAcceptance.title: All workflow failure/write/concurrency semantics
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Per-workflow and helper review of checkout/ref, writes, retries, conflict handling, concurrency, secrets, failure saving and retention. Real disposable-Git conflict/retry tests for repaired publication paths. No production dispatch.

remainingAcceptance.title: Actual provider entitlements and coverage
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Official provider account/plan/endpoint coverage plus authorized observed permission/refusal responses. Distinguish IEX/SIP/extended-hours and missing subscriptions; no purchases or exposed credentials.

remainingAcceptance.title: All-provider symbol/session normalization
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Inventory every provider symbol format, field units/clocks, exchange/session and corporate-action normalization; ambiguous aliases fail closed. Test representative preferred/share classes, ticker changes, DST/half days, missing/future/stale fields across actual ingress paths.

remainingAcceptance.title: Measured full-session freshness and latency
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Authorized observed full regular/premarket/half-day sessions with every intended minute, received/verified-universe denominators, BBO/trade/volume clocks, p95 latency, outages and last-success telemetry. Fixtures and job status cannot close this.

remainingAcceptance.title: Whole-market premarket discovery verified
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Old Massive-delayed Phase A is not valid real-time proof. Separately review/implement/pin revised explicit-universe SIP hybrid collector, budget and encrypted recovery, then obtain exact dated approval and measure actual broad coverage. Offline330-minute fixtures are not live evidence.

remainingAcceptance.title: Prospective matched lead/false-positive evaluation
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Pre-registered period/hypotheses/end date and minimum independent cases/days; first detection before observed+5/+10/+20/+25, executable quotes/control/benchmark, unresolved misses, costs, displayed size, drawdowns and clustered uncertainty. Actual cases currently0; no tuning/optional stopping.

remainingAcceptance.title: All-source ingestion and deduplication
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Source-by-source event identity, publication/ingestion clocks, stale/future/broken payloads, duplicate/revised stories, threat/materiality truthfulness and persistence across jobs. Include conflicting/missing source evidence.

remainingAcceptance.title: Independent point-in-time catalyst/missing-source audit
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Independently sourced contemporaneous filings/news/events, economic publication versus access timestamps, missing-source denominators and late-ingestion/missed-runner attribution. Current caches cannot authenticate past availability.

remainingAcceptance.title: Every approved recommendation and cached-render path
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Enumerate all current BUY/entry/action channels, monthly/basket/owner lanes, options, callbacks and cached reports. With missing/stale/expired/rejected/malformed/third-party marks, prove no approved BUY; test valid owner yes separately. Catalyst/cache repairs alone are partial.

remainingAcceptance.title: Cross-lane entry/stop/gap/cost consistency
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Compare every delivered plan to its registered tested entry/stop/exit/hold/cost/risk specification. Explicitly separate changed safety variants from original results; validate finite prices, opening gaps, no-price cases, sizing, realistic fees/slippage and liquidity.

remainingAcceptance.title: All-path fail-closed execution fault injection
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Inject errors/timeouts/redirects/config ambiguity/duplicate or resumed jobs on every mutation path. Prove no live broker host, method override or default opt-in mutation; unknown outcomes do not trigger blind retries. No actual order is needed or authorized.

remainingAcceptance.title: All send paths, stable IDs and cross-job durability
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Inventory every message and callback route; stable logical IDs, partial-message ACKs, unknown/reserved quarantine, confirmed persistence and safe reconciliation across independent jobs. Integrate reviewed journal where appropriate; no silent permission additions. Current journal is opt-in, not enabled globally.

remainingAcceptance.title: Authorized actual non-BUY delivery validation
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: After readiness review and explicit owner approval, prove a bounded non-sensitive non-BUY notification and independent run/recovery deduplication with real acknowledgments. No live BUY or trade permitted; mock contracts do not close this.

remainingAcceptance.title: Independent realistic after-cost replay
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Source-audited point-in-time universe including delistings, registered untouched holdout, next executable entry/exit, fees/spreads/liquidity/stress and consistent price basis. Separate corrected evidence from frozen firstRun; rejected outcomes retained.

remainingAcceptance.title: Actual identity/ticker/delisting/survivorship audit
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Independent security-level mappings at decision/entry/exit and as-known universe membership, ticker/class changes and documented terminal values. Admission shape/fixture checks do not authenticate sources or universe completeness.

remainingAcceptance.title: All performance claims and windows validated
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Catalogue each user-facing numerical/tested/proven/unseen claim, exact source/selection window, cost/hold basis and coverage. Authenticate/reproduce with separate audited evidence where possible; qualify unsupported claims without rewriting frozen results.

remainingAcceptance.title: Benchmark/capacity/drawdown/uncertainty report
remainingAcceptance.requiredVerification: Observed candidate/control/SPY paths and realistic costs, quote sizes/liquidity, censored gaps, adverse selection/capacity and drawdowns; predeclared clustered uncertainty/multiple-comparison rules and untouched confirmation. Quote-model fixtures alone cannot establish profitability.
